alert.title: Recurring checkout errors after a Friday deploy
alert.symptoms: Checkout error rate has spiked again shortly after today's Friday deploy, with the same connection-pool-exhaustion signature payments-api has shown after previous Friday deploys.
alert.error_message: payments-api reporting critical service health, database pool exhausted
alert.log_snippet:
2026-09-25T15:21:44Z PAGE payments-api service_health=CRITICAL reason=db_pool_exhausted
postgres: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
pool_utilization_pct=100.0% checkout_error_rate=26.3% deploy=v2.6.2 (9 min ago)

response.root_cause: Connection pool exhaustion in payments‑api likely caused by a recent code change that leaks or mismanages DB connections during the Friday deploy
response.blast_radius: All checkout transactions are failing, impacting every user attempting to purchase and causing a complete loss of revenue for the platform until resolved
first_actions: Inspect the latest Friday deploy diff for changes to DB connection handling or pool configuration
Check real‑time DB connection pool metrics and logs for leak patterns or spikes
If a leak is confirmed, either roll back the offending change or restart/payments‑api with an increased pool size as a temporary mitigation

New alert: Recurring checkout errors after a Friday deploy. Service: payments-api, severity: SEV1.
Symptoms: Checkout error rate has spiked again shortly after today's Friday deploy, with the same connection-pool-exhaustion signature payments-api has shown after previous Friday deploys.
Error: payments-api reporting critical service health, database pool exhausted

Evidence (only these incidents may be cited):
Incident INC-021 (payments-api, SEV1, 2026-08-28T15:55:08Z):
Symptoms: Same signature as INC-002/INC-009/INC-017: p99 latency above 4.9s and checkout errors above 24% about 8 minutes after the v2.5.0 Friday deploy.
Root cause: Fourth occurrence of the same unfixed order-confirmation session leak, triggered by the v2.5.0 Friday deploy.
Resolver: Priya Nair

Incident INC-017 (payments-api, SEV1, 2026-07-24T14:48:51Z):
Symptoms: Same signature as INC-002/INC-009: p99 latency above 4.7s and checkout errors above 22% about 10 minutes after the v2.4.0 Friday deploy.
Root cause: Same unresolved order-confirmation session leak, now triggered a third time by the v2.4.0 Friday deploy.
Resolver: Priya Nair

Incident INC-009 (payments-api, SEV1, 2026-06-19T15:10:47Z):
Symptoms: Same signature as INC-002: p99 latency above 4.6s and checkout errors above 20% about 15 minutes after the v2.3.1 Friday deploy.
Root cause: Same order-confirmation retry session leak as INC-002 (still unfixed in code), triggered again by Friday deploy traffic.
Resolver: Priya Nair

Incident INC-002 (payments-api, SEV1, 2026-05-15T14:32:10Z):
Symptoms: payments-api p99 latency above 4.8s and checkout error rate above 23% starting ~12 minutes after the v2.3.0 Friday deploy; new checkouts failing with DB connection errors.
Root cause: The v2.3.0 deploy's new order-confirmation retry path opens a DB session per retry without releasing it on timeout, exhausting the 20-connection Postgres pool within minutes of Friday peak traffic.
Resolver: Priya Nair

Ranked fixes (use the top one as first_actions[0]):
  1. increase_postgres_pool_size (score=+0.800, worked=3, partial=0, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
  2. kill_idle_db_connections (score=+0.625, worked=1, partial=1, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
  3. restart_payments_pods (score=+0.500, worked=0, partial=1, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
  4. rollback_to_previous_deploy (score=-0.050, worked=0, partial=0, failed=2, recent_failures=1)
RISKY fixes -- ledger failures exceed successes (do NOT recommend these in any first_action, not even as a last resort): rollback_to_previous_deploy
Recurrence: This is occurrence #5 of this pattern, recurring roughly every 35 days. The permanent fix from INC-021 is still open.
Team expert: Priya Nair (Resolved 4 incidents matching this pattern with a working fix.)
